listed.value: coherence-cli measures and maintains coherence in agentic systems — turning context, claims, meaning, provenance, and behavioral traces into inspectable signals so agents can decide what to trust, refresh, repair, route, or remember.

Five coherence domains, each under coherence/: quality (offline rule-based freshness/provenance/fidelity), meaning (Meaning Gradient anchor-axis projection), signal (source-agnostic series analysis: trend, pattern, resonance, forecast, collect), investiture (estimated micro-investiture), frames (frame provenance, inspect/diff, mixed-frame guard). Plus an assess multi-domain verb.

Console script entry point: coherence = coherence.cli:main; also python -m coherence via coherence/__main__.py. Package name coherence-cli, version 0.6.1, requires Python >=3.12, build backend hatchling.
Runtime dependencies: numpy>=1.26, httpx>=0.27. Dev dependencies: pytest, pytest-xdist, pytest-cov, bandit, flake8, isort, black, teken.
Exit-code policy: 0 success, 1 user-input error, 2 environment error, 3+ reserved. Errors raise CliError with a structured {code, message, remediation} shape and no Python traceback leaks to stderr.

CLI surface: global verbs whoami, learn, explain, overview, doctor, and the cli noun group; domain nouns meaning (score/compare/trend), quality (score/compare), signal (collect/trend/pattern/resonance/forecast), investiture (score/compare), frames (inspect/diff), and assess. Every verb supports --json; errors go to stderr, results to stdout.

Shared measurement envelope (coherence/schema.py): exactly five top-level keys — domain, score_type, scores, frame (dict, None, or a null-frame dict, never missing), diagnostics ([{code, message}]). New nouns (quality, signal, investiture, assess) emit the full envelope from day one; existing meaning verbs keep their pinned v0.5.0 shape and gain only additive domain/score_type/frame keys (two-speed rule).

Test suite: 48 test files under tests/ (per changelog, 665 tests, all offline in CI). CI runs uv run pytest -n auto --cov=coverage on push/PR to main (tests.yml), plus a lint job (black --check, isort --check-only, flake8, bandit, markdownlint-cli2, teken cli doctor . --strict) and a version-check job requiring every PR to bump pyproject.toml version.

Build/publish: uv sync for dev setup, uv build for the wheel, uv publish with PyPI Trusted Publishing (publish.yml). TestPyPI publish runs on PRs; real PyPI publish runs on push to main. SonarCloud quality gate when SONAR_TOKEN is set.

Mesh identity: culture.yaml declares agents with suffix coherence-cli and backend claude; CLAUDE.md is the matching prompt file. The repo is part of the AgentCulture mesh and vendored 11 guildmaster skills under .claude/skills/ (cite-don't-import), plus eidetic remember/recall skills with an in-repo public memory store at .eidetic/memory.

Assess (coherence/assess.py): multi-domain entry point that runs quality (always, offline), meaning (needs embedding endpoint; offline diagnostics preserved when unavailable), and investiture (derives from meaning, skipped if meaning unavailable), returning one envelope with domain=assess plus additive domains/unavailable keys; partial availability is a normal successful result, not an error.
